purpose: Consolidation ledger for behavior once explored through source/reference mods. Source/reference mods are inspiration/history only; no executing gameplay or presentation behavior from them is part of the owned realpass target. realpass starts from vanilla Cyberpunk identities and substitutes project-original mechanics where realism requires it.
